traits.name: Camouflage
traits.text: A grimstalker can Hide in natural environments, even if it doesn't have cover.

traits.name: Grimstalker Sap
traits.text: (poison); Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude. Maximum Duration 6 rounds Stage 1 1d6 (1d6) poison damage (1 round) Stage 2 1d6 (1d6) poison damage and clumsy 1 (1 round) Stage 3 2d6 (2d6) poison damage and clumsy 2 (1 round)

traits.name: Woodland Stride
traits.text: A grimstalker can always find a path, almost as if foliage parts before it. A grimstalker ignores difficult terrain caused by plants, such as bushes, vines, and undergrowth. Even plants manipulated by magic don't impede its progress.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +15 (agile); Damage 2d6+7 (2d6+7) slashing plus grimstalker sap
